# Loudoun Decks (LDN Decks)

> Custom deck builder serving Northern Virginia. Trex Platinum Partner and TimberTech Certified. 5.0★ Google rating. Licensed, insured, 2-year warranty.

## Company

- Name: Loudoun Decks
- Phone: (571) 655-7207
- Service area: Loudoun County, Fairfax County, Prince William County, Arlington County, Stafford County, Northern Virginia
- Certifications: Trex Platinum Partner, TimberTech Certified, BBB A+ Accredited
- Google rating: 5.0 stars, 49+ reviews

## Core Services

- [Custom Deck Building](https://ldndecks.com/services/new-decks): New composite and wood decks from $20k+
- [Deck Replacement](https://ldndecks.com/services/deck-replacement): Full tear-off and rebuild with composite
- [Deck Resurfacing](https://ldndecks.com/services/deck-resurfacing): Board-only upgrade keeping existing frame
- [Screened Porches](https://ldndecks.com/screened-porch-builder-northern-virginia): EZE-Breeze, retractable screens, three-season rooms
- [Deck Repair](https://ldndecks.com/services/deck-repair-and-structural-maintenance): Structural fixes, rotted posts, failed inspections
- [Outdoor Kitchens](https://ldndecks.com/outdoor-kitchen-builder-northern-virginia): Built-in grills, bars, pizza ovens
- [Patios](https://ldndecks.com/services/patios): Pavers, flagstone, stamped concrete
- [Pergolas & Gazebos](https://ldndecks.com/services/gazebo-pergola): Attached and freestanding shade structures
- [Fencing](https://ldndecks.com/services/fence): Wood, vinyl, aluminum, composite
- [Deck Washing](https://ldndecks.com/services/deck-washing): Pressure washing and restoration
